name: Titanium.UI.ActivityIndicator
summary: An activity indicator that lets the user know an action is taking place.
description:
| Android | iOS |
| ------- | --- |
| ![Android](./activityindicator_android.png) | ![iOS](./activityindicator_ios.png) |

An activity indicator can be used to show the progress of an operation in the UI to let the
user know that some action is taking place. An activity indicator consists of a spinning
animation and an optional text message, and is used to indicate an ongoing activity of
indeterminate length. To show progress, use [Titanium.UI.ProgressBar](api:Titanium.UI.ProgressBar) instead.

Use the [Titanium.UI.createActivityIndicator](api:Titanium.UI#createActivityIndicator) method or **`<ActivityIndicator>`** Alloy element to
create an `ActivityIndicator` object.

`ActivityIndicator` is a view and, like any view, must be added to a window or other top-level
view before it can be shown. Unlike most views, `ActivityIndicator` is hidden by
default and must be shown explicitly by calling its [Titanium.UI.ActivityIndicator.show](api:Titanium.UI.ActivityIndicator#show) method.

Alloy XML Markup

properties.name: bottom
properties.description:
Determines the absolute position of the view relative to its parent.

Can be either a float value or a dimension string (for example `100` or `'50%'`.)

properties.name: color
properties.summary: Color of the message text, as a color name or hex triplet.
properties.description: For information about color values, see the "Colors" section of [Titanium.UI](api:Titanium.UI).

properties.name: font
properties.summary: Font used for the message text.

properties.name: height
properties.summary:
Width of the view. Only accepts value of [Titanium.UI.SIZE](api:Titanium.UI#SIZE), which must be explicitly set in order to
display the message and to position the view correctly.

properties.name: indicatorColor
properties.description: For information about color values, see the "Colors" section of [Titanium.UI](api:Titanium.UI).

properties.name: left
properties.description:
Determines the absolute position of the view relative to its parent.

Can be either a float value or a dimension string (for example `100` or `'50%'`.)

properties.name: messageid
properties.summary: Key identifying a string in the locale file to use for the message text.
properties.description: Only one of `message` or `messageid` should be specified.

properties.name: right
properties.description:
Determines the absolute position of the view relative to its parent.

Can be either a float value or a dimension string (for example `100` or `'50%'`.)

properties.name: style
properties.summary: The style for the activity indicator.
properties.description:
One of the activity indicator style constants.

See also: [indicatorColor](api:Titanium.UI.ActivityIndicator#indicatorColor)

properties.name: top
properties.description:
Determines the absolute position of the view relative to its parent.

Can be either a float value or a dimension string (for example `100` or`'50%'`.)

properties.name: width
properties.summary:
Width of the view. Only accepts value of [Titanium.UI.SIZE](api:Titanium.UI#SIZE), which must be explicitly set in order to
display the message and to position the view correctly.

methods.name: hide
methods.summary: Hides the activity indicator and stops the animation.

methods.name: show
methods.summary: Shows the activity indicator and starts the animation.
methods.description:
Remember to add the activity indicator to a parent view first,
so it centers properly. This is optional for Android and required
for iOS.
